services.desc: What better way to spend your upcoming special occasion than with your friends, family, or colleagues aboard Lovely Martha! We will set you up with a celebration like never before. We launch from the heart of Fisherman's Wharf. After that we can cruise around all the best sights in the San Francisco Bay or set out on an adventure past the Golden Gate and out onto the open water! Cruises can include sightseeing, fishing, excursions, or just relaxing on the open water. book online Private charters are $500/hour with a 2 hour minimum. blurb: The Lovely Martha offers shared and private fishing trips, party cruises, special events, bay tours, and memorials at sea. The boat is a classic 50’ wooden-hulled vessel operating out of San Francisco Fisherman’s Wharf. Capt. Mike Rescino has provided fishing experiences for over 100 years through four generations of the Rescino Family.
